Read the contract from your side.
Score it. Redline it.

Drop in an NDA, MSA, DPA, or licence. Get a favorability score, a clause-by-clause review you drive, and a validated .docx with tracked changes and threaded comments authored as you.

Install Watch the demo
36-second overview with sound. Autoplay starts muted — unmute in the player.

How it works

  1. Analyse

    Fixes which side you're on, reads the whole document, and scores every clause against a market-standard playbook — including clauses that are missing.

  2. Review

    An interactive review shows each finding with the off-market language and an editable suggested edit. Accept, rewrite, comment, or reject — clause by clause.

  3. Apply

    One button sends your decisions straight back to Claude — no file to export, upload, or paste.

  4. Redline

    Regenerates the original .docx with tracked changes and native comments authored as you, replies to and closes the counterparty's existing threads where you agree, and returns a changelog.

Install

Claude Code — add the marketplace and install the plugin:

/plugin marketplace add SaarthiOS/contract-review
/plugin install contract-review@saarthios-skills

claude.ai (Pro, Max, Team, or Enterprise with code execution) — zip the skill folder and upload it under Settings → Features → Skills:

cd plugins/contract-review/skills && zip -r contract-review.zip contract-review

On claude.ai, custom skills are per-user; Team/Enterprise owners can provision it org-wide from Organization settings.

Then just ask

Review this NDA from our side as the receiving party
and redline anything one-sided.
Self-contained: the redline engine is original code, makes no network calls, and has no external skill dependency. This is decision support, not legal advice — have a qualified lawyer review before signing.
